title: Von Neumann algebras as reduced twisted groupoid $C^*$-algebras
summary: We characterize the von Neumann algebras that are isomorphic, as $C^*$-algebras, to reduced twisted $C^*$-algebras of locally compact Hausdorff groupoids equipped with continuous Haar systems of full support. They are exactly the subhomogeneous von Neumann algebras, equivalently finite products of matrix algebras over abelian von Neumann algebras. The groupoid can always be chosen compact, principal, and étale, with trivial twist and counting Haar system.
